meta.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Building Permits Survey, monthly year-to-date files
meta.generated_at_note: the month the figures run through, not the time this ran, so a refetch of the same month writes the same bytes
meta.measure: housing units permitted January–August 2026 against the same months of 2025; total includes Census estimates for offices that did not report, reported is the reported-only part; multifamily is 2 or more units
meta.place_rule: a town is shown only when its permit office reported every month this year and all but at most 1 last year (a month filed late shows as missing in the file Census published then); otherwise its figure is a Census estimate and is null
meta.change_rule: change_pct is read only when each period has at least 50 homes
